Ferrari Silicon Valley is delighted to showcase this exceptional Pre-Owned 2022 Porsche 718 Spyder. Finished in stunning Carrara White Metallic over a rich Bordeaux Red leather interior, and showing just 907 miles, this open-top sports car embodies precision engineering, analog engagement, and unmistakable road presence.
With its low, purposeful stance and signature rear buttresses, the 718 Spyder is a modern interpretation of Porsches motorsport heritage. This example is equipped with full-bucket seats that provide lightweight construction and superior lateral support, perfectly complementing the cars focused driving dynamics. The Spyder classic interior package enhances the cabin with refined detailing that blends sport and sophistication.


Inside, the bold Bordeaux Red leather interior creates a dramatic contrast to the exterior finish. The driver is treated to a tactile and immersive experience, heightened by the engaging 6-speed manual transmission, delivering pure connection between car and driver. Comfort and technology are equally present, with the BOSE Surround Sound System providing rich, immersive audio and Porsche Dynamic Light System Plus ensuring optimal visibility in all driving conditions.

Engine and Performance: Powering the 718 Spyder is a naturally aspirated 4.0 liter flat six engine producing 414 horsepower and 309 lb ft of torque. Paired with the 6-speed manual gearbox, this mid-engine roadster accelerates from 0 to 60 mph in just 4.2 seconds. With razor-sharp steering, a perfectly balanced chassis, and a high-revving powerband, the 718 Spyder delivers one of the most engaging driving experiences available in a modern sports car.

Key Features:

• Full-Bucket Seats: Lightweight carbon fiber seats offering exceptional support and a race-inspired feel.

• BOSE Surround Sound System: Premium audio performance for an immersive listening experience.

• Porsche Dynamic Light System Plus: Advanced adaptive lighting for enhanced visibility and safety.

• Spyder Classic Interior Package: Adds refined detailing that complements the cars sporting character.

• 6-Speed Manual Transmission: Provides direct, engaging control for a true enthusiast driving experience.

This 2022 Porsche 718 Spyder is far more than just a car, it is the embodiment of the brand's commitment to peak automotive engineering and opulent design. description: The 2024 Chevrolet Corvette Stingray 2LT is a high-performance sports car masterpiece that blends blistering speed, precision engineering, and everyday usability into one exhilarating package. The 8-speed dual-clutch transmission delivers lightning-quick shifts crisp and precise like a race car but smooth for everyday use. With the Z51 Performance Package, this Stingray can sprint 0-60 mph in about 2.9 seconds, making it one of the fastest cars in its class. Race-Inspired Handling The mid-engine design improves weight distribution and cornering balance, while available Magnetic Selective Ride Control intelligently adapts suspension firmness on the fly for control and comfort. Optional Z51 upgrades like performance Brembo brakes and track-ready suspension components boost grip and braking confidence when the road gets twisty. Premium 2LT Features Comfort The 2LT trim elevates the Stingray experience with a suite of upscale tech and comfort amenities beyond the base model: Heated and ventilated GT2 bucket seats with power adjustments 14-speaker Bose Performance Series audio for concert-quality sound Performance Data Recorder to capture track sessions and cruising runs Head-Up Display to keep key driving info in your line of sight Wireless smartphone charging advanced infotainment with navigation Safety tech like Side Blind Zone Alert and Rear Cross Traffic Alert Striking Design Presence From its aerodynamic sculpted body and quad exhaust tips to its available striking colors and stripe packages, the Corvette Stingray commands attention. The mid-engine stance isnt just for looks it also enhances stability and performance at high speed. In short, the 2024 Corvette Stingray 2LT isnt just a car its an emotion-inducing blend of raw power, precision handling, and upscale technology that stands out whether youre carving canyon roads, blasting laps, or just enjoying a weekend drive.
